Interface CancellableWithReason

All Superinterfaces:
org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
All Known Implementing Classes:
PreCompanyCreateEvent, PreOrderAcceptEvent, PreOrderCreateEvent
public interface CancellableWithReason extends org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
An event that stops an action when it is cancelled, and tells the player who triggered the action why.

Cancel with cancel(Component) to show your own reason. setCancelled(true) without a reason shows a generic message that an integration prevented the action. Un-cancelling the event drops the reason. When the action was triggered through the API, the reason is passed back to the calling plugin instead.
